name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.qchatkit.ui.server.QChatCreateWayActivity
description: The NetEase Yunxin QChat UI SDK opens this chooser when a user starts a server setup flow. It offers creating a server or joining an existing one, including the corresponding announcement-server choices.
disableEffect: Users cannot start the built-in QChat server creation or joining flow from this chooser.
